items.title: Chevron to Invest $7 Billion in Venezuela, Doubling Production
items.summary: Other oil-and-gas companies, including Italian giant ENI and smaller U.S. players Primavera and Aspect Holdings, signed production deals as well.

items.title: Cramer Called the September Open Unholy and Then Named the One Stock He Would Still Buy
items.summary: Jim Cramer called the September market open unholy, rattled off geopolitical chaos, and then named exactly one stock worth buying above $200. Whether the fundamentals behind that call survive the noise is a harder question than it looks.

items.title: 3 Reasons We Love ConocoPhillips (COP)
items.summary: ConocoPhillips has followed the market’s trajectory closely, rising in tandem with the S&P 500 over the past six months. The stock has climbed by 15.3% to $136.36 per share while the index has gained 11.8%.

items.title: Chevron unveils $7 billion Venezuela deal as US claims a fifth of the country's oil
items.summary: Chevron announced a $7 billion expansion deal for its Venezuelan operations on Wednesday, hours after the country's parliament approved handing Washington control over a fifth of its oil reserves.View on euronews

items.title: Energy ETFs to Watch as US-Venezuela Sign Historic Oil Deal
items.summary: Energy ETFs could benefit as the U.S.-Venezuela oil deal drives long-term investment in Venezuela's oil infrastructure.

items.title: Oil Price Rally Helps Energy Stocks, Hurts Airlines
items.summary: The 5% jump in U.S. crude oil prices today is having some of the familiar effects we've seen in recent months across the market when tensions build in the Middle East.    Winners largely are coming from the energy sector, which is the best performing group in the S&P 500 today.

items.title: Goldman Sachs refreshes conviction lists on both sides of the Atlantic
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs updated its U.S. and European conviction lists for September, adding several new names as it refreshed its highest-conviction ideas heading into the autumn.

items.title: Is ConocoPhillips Stock Outperforming the Dow?
items.summary: As ConocoPhillips has outperformed relative to the Dow over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a strongly optimistic outlook on the stock’s prospects.
